major.name: Death-marked
major.card: Frightened of you, and can't regain hit points

severe.name: Stilled
severe.card: Paralyzed — its body forgets it is alive

offensive.name: Finality
offensive.description: Everything that has begun to end, you are allowed to finish.

tiers.text: The damage is turned into Necrotic damage. A creature this seal leaves with no more hit points than half the damage it just took drops to 0 hit points — it had already begun to end.
tiers.card: Damage becomes Necrotic · left with HP ≤ half the damage it took: drops to 0

tiers.text: The line moves. A creature left with no more hit points than the damage it just took drops to 0, and a creature that drops this way cannot be stabilized by nonmagical means.
tiers.card: Left with HP ≤ the damage it took: drops to 0 · no nonmagical stabilizing

tiers.text: Temporary hit points no longer shelter it — they are ignored when you measure what is left — and a creature that drops to 0 this way fails its first death saving throw automatically.
tiers.card: Temp HP don't count toward what's left · dropped this way: first death save fails automatically

tiers.text: The line moves again. A creature left with no more hit points than twice the damage it just took drops to 0 — and dies. No death saving throws. It is simply over.
tiers.card: Left with HP ≤ twice the damage it took: dies outright, no death saves

offensive.name: Doom
offensive.description: It was always coming. Now it has a date.

tiers.text: A creature that fails is Doomed. At the end of its third turn from now the Doom arrives: it takes half the damage this seal dealt it again, plus 4 additional damage dice of the seal's type, all as Necrotic damage. Healing does not delay it and running does not escape it.
tiers.card: Doomed — at the end of their third turn, half this seal's damage lands again, carrying 4 extra dice

conditions.name: Doomed
conditions.duration: until the end of their third turn from now

tiers.text: The Doom comes sooner and harder: at the end of the creature's second turn from now, for the full damage this seal dealt it, and the extra dice it carries become 8. Only a dispelling of the Doom itself, or an opposing seal, stops the count.
tiers.card: Arrives at the end of their second turn — the full damage again, and its extra dice become 8 · only a dispel or an opposing seal stops it

conditions.name: Doomed
conditions.duration: until the end of their second turn from now

tiers.text: A Doom must be paid by someone, and it has grown heavy with waiting: its extra dice become 12. If the Doomed creature is already dead when it arrives, it falls on the nearest creature hostile to you instead. While the count runs, the Doomed creature has disadvantage on death saving throws.
tiers.card: Its extra dice become 12 · if they're already dead, it lands on your nearest enemy · disadvantage on death saves while it counts down

tiers.text: Name the hour. You may set the Doom to arrive at any moment you choose within the next 24 hours, wherever the creature is and however far it has run, and nothing short of Wish or an opposing seal lifts it. Everything it has waited for comes due at once: its extra dice become 16.
tiers.card: Set the hour — any time in the next 24 hrs, anywhere they are · its extra dice become 16 · only Wish or an opposing seal lifts it

supportive.name: Not Yet
supportive.description: Death is standing in the doorway. For you, it has decided to wait.

tiers.text: If the target drops to 0 hit points while this lasts, it does not fall — not yet. It stays conscious until the end of its next turn and may move and take one action; only then does it fall and begin making death saving throws.
tiers.card: Drop to 0 and keep going — conscious through their next turn, one action, then fall

tiers.text: The first time the target would drop to 0 hit points while this lasts, it drops to 1 instead.
tiers.card: The first time they'd drop to 0, they drop to 1 instead

tiers.text: When that happens, the target stands on the threshold: until the end of its next turn it has resistance to all damage and cannot be reduced below 1 hit point.
tiers.card: When it triggers: resistance to all damage and can't drop below 1 until the end of their next turn

buff.resist: all damage until the end of their next turn

tiers.text: Death will take someone, but it does not greatly care who. When a creature under this effect would die, any willing creature within 30 feet — you included — may take its place: the willing one drops to 0 hit points and begins dying, and the one it saved is left standing on 1.
tiers.card: When they'd die, any willing creature within 30 ft (you too) can take their place — dropping to 0 so they stay on 1

supportive.name: Pale Walker
supportive.description: You have one foot on the other side. It turns out the dead have their advantages.

tiers.text: You no longer need to breathe, you have resistance to necrotic damage, and you have advantage on saving throws against disease and poison.
tiers.card: No need to breathe · resistance to necrotic · advantage vs disease and poison

tiers.text: You cannot be Frightened, Poisoned, or Exhausted, and you see invisible spirits and undead within 60 feet. The price: you count as undead for anything that singles out the undead — Turn Undead included.
tiers.card: Can't be Frightened, Poisoned or Exhausted · see spirits and undead 60 ft · but you count as undead (Turn Undead works on you)

tiers.text: You walk as the dead do. You can move through creatures and objects as though they were difficult terrain, taking 1d10 force damage if you end your turn inside one, and you have resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
tiers.card: Move through creatures and objects (1d10 force if you end inside one) · resistance to nonmagical physical damage

tiers.text: For now, you are dead and walking. You are immune to necrotic and poison damage and cannot be Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Exhausted. Healing no longer reaches you — but whenever a creature within 30 feet dies, you take something from it and regain Five Times your Verum Modifier in hit points.
tiers.card: Immune to necrotic and poison, charm, fear, paralysis and exhaustion · healing can't reach you · regain 5×VM whenever something within 30 ft dies

control.name: Destined Death
control.description: Death is not just probable — it is prophesied. The thread tightens. It was always going to.

tiers.text: The target is Marked. If reduced to 0 HP before the mark fades (1 minute), they cannot be stabilized by nonmagical means and begin dying with disadvantage on all death saving throws.
tiers.card: Marked 1 min — at 0 HP no nonmagical stabilising, death saves at disadvantage

tiers.text: The Mark deepens. If the target dies while Marked, no spell of 5th level or lower can revive them — Revivify, Raise Dead, and similar effects fail automatically.
tiers.card: Die while Marked and nothing of 5th or lower revives them

tiers.text: The Mark reaches the soul's root. If the target dies while Marked, no magic may detect, contact, or interact with their soul until the Mark is dispelled — requiring Wish, True Resurrection, or divine intervention. Even then, success may require a contested roll vs your Verum DC.
tiers.card: Die while Marked and no magic can reach their soul until the Mark is dispelled

tiers.text: Once per long rest, invoke True Destined Death. On a failed save, the Mark becomes absolute — if the target dies, their soul dissolves into the Loom of Creation. No magic, divine authority, dreamwalking, or intervention of any kind can retrieve it. Not Wish. Not True Resurrection. Not a Forerunner. Additionally: The Executioner notices. The DM determines the consequences.
tiers.card: 1/long rest True Destined Death — fail and the soul dissolves into the Loom. Nothing returns them

control.name: The Stillness
control.description: A heart has a finite number of beats. You are spending theirs.

tiers.text: A creature that fails has its speed halved and can take no reactions until the end of its next turn.
tiers.card: Speed halved · no reactions until the end of their next turn

tiers.text: While the Stillness holds, the creature can take an action or a bonus action on its turn, never both, and no reactions at all.
tiers.card: While it holds: an action OR a bonus action each turn, never both · no reactions

penalty.actions: an action or a bonus action, not both

tiers.text: The beats grow further apart. On each of its turns the creature must choose: move, or act. It cannot do both.
tiers.card: Each turn they choose — move or act, never both

tiers.text: The heart stops between beats. The first time a creature fails against this seal it is Paralyzed through its next turn; after that the Stillness only slows it, as above. A creature that drops to 0 hit points while the Stillness holds it dies outright.
tiers.card: First fail: Paralyzed through their next turn, then slowed · dropping to 0 while it holds = dead outright

conditions.name: Paralyzed
conditions.duration: through their next turn, first failure only

creation.name: Necropolis
creation.description: Every battlefield is a graveyard that has not been told yet.

tiers.text: Your creations are made of the dead. A Construct is raised from a corpse within range — or from old grave-dust if there is none — and is undead. Structures are bone and cold earth: a creature that touches or strikes one takes 1d6 necrotic damage. Objects are grave-goods and deal an extra 1d4 necrotic damage on a hit.
tiers.card: Constructs are undead, raised from a corpse · Structures 1d6 necrotic to touch · Objects +1d4 necrotic

tiers.text: The dead feed the dead. Whenever a creature dies within 30 feet of one of your creations, each of your creations there regains hit points equal to Five Times your Verum Modifier.
tiers.card: When anything dies within 30 ft, your creations regain 5×VM each

tiers.text: Raise the fresh dead. Instead of choosing a stat block, a Construct may be raised from a creature that died within the last minute, using its own statistics if its CR is no higher than the slot — it keeps its attacks and remembers how to use them, and it is undead and yours.
tiers.card: Raise a Construct from something dead within the minute — its own stat block, if its CR ≤ the slot

tiers.text: What falls to your dead stands back up. A creature killed by one of your creations rises at the start of your next turn as a Shade under your command — undead, with its own statistics at half its hit points, if its CR is no higher than the slot — lasting until the seal ends. A destroyed Construct rises again once per seal at half its hit points.
tiers.card: Anything your creations kill rises next turn as your Shade until the seal ends · a destroyed Construct rises once at half HP

utility.name: The Threshold
utility.description: You do not fear the door. You have keys, and you know the one who keeps it.

tiers.text: Know how, and roughly when, anything within 60 feet died. Ask a corpse that died within the last day three questions, and hear what it knew in life. Remains you touch do not decay while the seal lasts.
tiers.card: Know how and when anything within 60 ft died · three questions to a corpse dead within a day · halt decay

tiers.text: Feel the dying. Sense any creature within a mile that is at 0 hit points or close to death, and in which direction. Undead of a lower CR than your level ignore you and up to three companions unless you act against them.
tiers.card: Sense anyone dying within a mile · undead below your level ignore you and three companions

tiers.text: Step onto the threshold itself. For up to 1 minute you stand between life and death — unseen by the living, passing through walls and floors, able to see and speak with any spirit within 300 feet. While you stand there you cannot touch the living, and they cannot touch you.
tiers.card: Up to 1 min on the threshold — unseen, through walls, speaking with spirits 300 ft · you can't touch the living, or they you

tiers.text: Speak with anyone who has died, anywhere, so long as their soul still exists somewhere to answer. Or put one question to Death about how, or when, a named creature will die — and receive an answer that is true, if rarely kind.
tiers.card: Speak with anyone dead, wherever their soul still exists · or ask Death how or when someone will die

complementEffects.name: Toll
complementEffects.description: Every death pays a toll to someone. You have arranged to be that someone.

effect.text: On a hit or failed saving throw, the target takes bonus Necrotic damage equal to one damage die of the primary effect's type (min 1d6). If this seal drops the target to 0 hit points, one creature of your choice within 30 feet gains temporary hit points equal to Twice your Verum Modifier.
effect.card: +1 die necrotic · if the seal kills, someone within 30 ft gains 2×VM temp HP

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Bonus damage increases to two dice, and the temporary hit points become Three Times your Verum Modifier.
Level 11+: Bonus damage increases to three dice, and on a kill the chosen creature also has advantage on its next attack roll or saving throw.
upgrades.card: +3 dice · on a kill they also get advantage on their next attack or save

buff.advantage: next attack roll or saving throw

complementEffects.name: Borrowed Time
complementEffects.description: It is not free. It was never going to be free.

effect.text: When the primary effect resolves, name one creature within 30 feet. The next time it would drop to 0 hit points before the end of your next turn, it drops to 1 instead — and gains one level of Exhaustion, because the time had to come from somewhere.
effect.card: One creature within 30 ft: its next drop to 0 before your next turn becomes 1 — but it gains a level of Exhaustion

buff.until: the end of your next turn

upgrades.text: Level 5+: You may name up to two creatures, and the protection lasts for 1 minute.
upgrades.card: Up to two creatures · lasts 1 minute

upgrades.text: Level 11+: The debt is forgiven — no Exhaustion — and a creature saved this way also gains temporary hit points equal to Twice your Verum Modifier.
upgrades.card: No more Exhaustion · a saved creature also gains 2×VM temp HP

complementEffects.name: Knell
complementEffects.description: The bell is not ringing for them yet. It is practising.

effect.text: Creatures that fail hear the bell in their chest and are Frightened of you until the end of their next turn.
effect.card: Frightened of you until the end of their next turn

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.duration: until the end of their next turn

upgrades.text: Level 5+: They also have disadvantage on death saving throws for 1 minute. Death has noticed them.
upgrades.card: Also disadvantage on death saves for 1 minute

upgrades.text: Level 11+: A creature that drops below half its hit points while Frightened this way freezes where it stands — its speed becomes 0 and it can take no reactions until the fear ends.
upgrades.card: Below half HP while Frightened: speed 0 and no reactions until it ends
